experiments.title: A prediction rule and its loss
experiments.description: Move parameters while observations stay fixed. Blue points are observations; the green line is the current prediction.

experiments.title: Projection and an orthogonal residual
experiments.description: The allowed approximations lie on the green direction. The blue target splits into projection and residual.

experiments.title: Least squares as a projection
experiments.description: Change one target, then refit the intercept and slope. The residual sum and distance-weighted sum should remain near zero.

experiments.title: A matrix transforms the unit circle
experiments.description: A blue unit circle becomes a green ellipse. Singular values are its principal semiaxis lengths.

experiments.title: PCA and rank-one reconstruction
experiments.description: Blue points are centered data; green points are their closest reconstructions along the leading principal direction.

experiments.title: Tangent and finite differences
experiments.description: The quadratic curve, tangent at x, and secant from x to x+h are computed from the controls.

experiments.title: From rectangles to an integral
experiments.description: Accumulate exp(x) on [0,1]. Left rectangles and trapezoids approximate the exact integral e − 1.

experiments.title: A scalar neural forward and backward pass
experiments.description: z = wx + b; a = tanh(z); loss = (a − y)² / 2. Compare the analytic weight derivative with central differences.

experiments.title: Step size and curvature
experiments.description: Run 40 actual gradient steps on (x² + curvature × y²) / 2. The graph shows log10(1 + loss), preserving large-value visibility.

experiments.title: Bayes and the reference population
experiments.description: Compute P(distant | late) from the distant-route prior and conditional late rates. This is a conditional probability, not a causal claim.

experiments.title: The distribution of sample means
experiments.description: Generate 1,000 batches of independent Bernoulli trials with the same reset seed. The histogram is over batch averages, not individual binary outcomes.

experiments.title: A beta prior meets Bernoulli data
experiments.description: Update prior shapes by successes and failures. A separate simulation uses independent N(0,1) observations, n=20, and 500 repeated datasets to show known-variance 95% interval coverage.

experiments.title: Stable binary probability and loss
experiments.description: Change a logit score over an extreme range. Probability, loss, and gradient are evaluated using stable formulas.
